screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a histogram or a count-rate chart of a simulated counting source, alongside a panel of summary statistics.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you set the simulated source's activity, choose a simulation speed, choose which chart is shown, set the counting interval and run length, start and stop recording, choose which theoretical curves to show, set the histogram bin width, export the data, and reset the simulation.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Collect a run of measurements, then switch between the histogram and the count-rate chart to see what the data shows.

preferences.title: Simulation
preferences.showDiagnosticsDescription: Adds the raw count register and GM tube voltage to the source panel, for checking how a connected counter reports its counts.
preferences.beepEnabledDescription: When unchecked, silences the audible count indicator on a connected PASCO Wireless Geiger Counter.
preferences.tubeVoltageDescription: Bias applied to a connected counter's G-M tube. Use a plateau experiment to explore how count rate depends on voltage.
